faq-items.question: What does Ghanchi Investments do?
faq-items.answer: We provide goal-based financial planning and support across life insurance, health insurance, mutual funds, retirement, child education, personal accident, general insurance and employer–employee insurance.

faq-items.question: How does financial planning begin?
faq-items.answer: We begin by understanding your goals, concerns, risk appetite and cash flows. Recommendations are customized around those needs.

faq-items.question: How do I choose insurance cover?
faq-items.answer: Start with your needs and dependants, and review coverage, exclusions, waiting periods, premiums and eligibility. Benefits depend on the selected policy and its terms.

faq-items.question: Where can I access my investments or renew a policy?
faq-items.answer: The Online Services page links to LIC, Fundz Bazar, NJ account portals and insurer renewal pages. These are external provider websites with their own terms and security controls.

faq-items.question: Who do you work with?
faq-items.answer: Our clients include individuals, families, business owners, NRIs and professionals across India and abroad. Advice considers your specific needs rather than a standard package.

faq-items.question: Do you help implement the plan?
faq-items.answer: Yes. Ghanchi Investments assists with implementing recommendations and provides an annual review.

faq-items.question: Do you assist with claims?
faq-items.answer: Ghanchi Investments provides after-sales service and assistance with claim settlement. The insurer determines claim eligibility under the policy terms.

faq-items.question: Are the ratings updated live?
faq-items.answer: No. The displayed 5.0 rating is the owner-approved value from the existing Ghanchi website. Google synchronization has not been connected.

faq-items.question: Where are you based?
faq-items.answer: Our office is at Shop no. 27, Sector 11, Balaji Bhavan, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400614. Call +91 9820926446 or +91 7977061717 to get in touch.

faq-items.question: What should I share in an enquiry?
faq-items.answer: Tell us your broad goal and the services you are interested in. Do not include passwords, account credentials or sensitive financial documents in the website form.

faq-items.question: Do you guarantee investment returns?
faq-items.answer: No. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks and past performance does not guarantee future returns. Review all scheme and policy documents before deciding.
